opportunities.name: Tech lead research (HN + GitHub) and note
opportunities.description: For a given project name, find the top HN story via search, look up the GitHub repo for stars and latest release, then save a 'Lead' note summarizing both.
steps: Search the project name on HN (Algolia or ycombinator search)
Note the top story title, points and age
Open GitHub, search the project name and open the top repo
Read star count and last release date
Open notes app, add new note 'Lead: <name>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>'
